content:
The 2014 Dow Corning Tennis Classic was a professional tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It was the 26th edition of the tournament which was part of the 2014 ITF Women's Circuit, offering a total of $100,000 in prize money. It took place in Midland, Michigan, United States, from February 10 to February 16, 2014.

Heather Watson won the singles title, defeating Ksenia Pervak in the final with a score of 6-4, 6-0. This was Watson's 2nd title of the year and the 7th of her career. 

In doubles, the duo of Sharon Fichman and Maria Sanchez clinched the title, defeating Melanie Oudin and Taylor Townsend 6-3, 5-7, [11-9] in a closely contested match. 

The Dow Corning Tennis Classic is considered a significant event on the ITF Women's Circuit and has a reputation for showcasing rising stars in the world of women's professional tennis. Other past participants include notable players such as Maria Sharapova, Serena Williams, and Victoria Azarenka.

The Dow Corning Tennis Classic also has a commitment to community involvement, including a kids’ fun day, high school play day, community tennis clinic, and the participation of players in local school visits during the week of the tournament.
